text:
Amelia: Morning — quick async check on AcmeHealth embeddings surge overnight (CS-4521). What I did: flagged to eng, pulled request ids and short trace snippets. Blockers: need an eng canary and a safe mitigation we can communicate to the customer. Today: propose a 10% canary + temporary batching tweak. Ping @juan @raj @marta for help.

Raj: Got it. Can you drop a couple request_ids, model name and region? I’ll check GPU utilization, queue lengths and p99 histograms.

Amelia: Pasted two sample ids: `req_20260317_8471` and `req_20260317_8499`. Model: `openllm-embed-v2-quant`. Region: us-west-2. Ticket: <https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4521>

cs-bot: alert — embeddings-p99 latency > 2.5s for AcmeHealth (us-west-2) between 02:10-03:30 UTC. Related alerts: embeddings_queue_length_high.

Juan: Thanks. My first guess is KV cache cold/miss or an unexpected spike in small/bad batches. Repro command you can run locally: 
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"openllm-embed-v2-quant","input":"test latency sample"}'
```
I'll prepare a canary branch `fix/embed-cache-ttl` and spin a canary at ~13:00 UTC. Will post canary endpoint once up.

Raj: I'll collect a quick snapshot: `kubectl top pods -n redwood-serving | grep embed` and check Grafana -> Embeddings -> p99 by region. If you want, I can pin 10% traffic to the canary via a routing rule to limit blast radius.

Marta: I can draft the CS-facing note to AcmeHealth and coordinate the customer toggle (we can adjust per-customer batching). Suggested quick mitigation: set `batch_size=8` and `prefix_cache=on` for this customer profile — that can be pushed instantly as a config change.

dmitri_oncall: noted. If canary looks good at 10% I'll promote. If outputs regress we should revert and fallback to `openllm-embed-v1` for AcmeHealth. I’ll monitor and join if alarms pop. :thumbsup:

Juan: Canary endpoint up: `https://canary-us-west-2.embed.redwood.internal/`. Running 100 synthetic requests now and will paste numbers. If anyone observes odd semantics in embeddings (dup tokens or weird vectors), flag here.

Amelia: I told Sarah (AcmeHealth lead) we'll run a 10% canary and follow up in 30m. Marta — can you post the short FYI to the ticket and include fallback plan?

Marta: Draft posted to CS ticket and pinged Sarah. Contact for rollback: `sarah@acmehealth.com`. No legal approval required for this config-level canary.

cs-bot: deployment job `canary-deploy/embed-fix` succeeded at 2026-03-17T13:02:10Z.

Juan: First 100 synthetic runs on canary: p50=120ms p95=340ms p99=480ms. Production p99 for that window was ~2.6s — looks promising. Leaving canary at 10% for 30m and will re-run 1k synthetic requests after 15m.

Raj: GPU snapshot shows low mem pressure and no OOMs. Queue-length histogram looks healthy after canary routing. I’ll keep a close eye on the batch-size distribution and KV cache hit ratio.

Amelia: Fantastic — I’ll update the customer with the canary note and tentative timeline. Will reconvene if any regression shows up. Thanks everyone!
